notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers installing MongoDB 7 from the official apt repository, creating admin/app users and enabling auth, mongosh CRUD, indexing and aggregation examples, replica set setup with a keyfile, mongodump/mongorestore, a three-node Docker Compose replica set, monitoring queries and mongod.conf tuning.

Medium: following it has the agent add the MongoDB apt repo and signing key with sudo, install packages, edit /etc/mongod.conf, restart services, generate and chmod a keyfile, create database users, and run backup/restore commands with database credentials. Acceptable because these are standard administration steps for the user's own MongoDB deployment, the apt repo is signed (signed-by keyring), and the destructive commands (deleteMany, dropIndex, `mongorestore --drop` at SKILL.md:264-265) are shown as a reference, not as steps to run unprompted; confirm with the user before running them against real data.

Users should know: passwords (strong_admin_password, secret) are placeholders and should not be used as-is; the replica-set and tuning configs bind to 0.0.0.0 (SKILL.md:209, 398), which needs firewalling. Related Skills (SKILL.md:418-420) link to sibling skills ../redis/, ../database-backups/, ../postgresql/ as optional reading only.
